# ArrayUniqueCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.2" />

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `ArrayUniqueCanBeUsedInspection`

Counting occurrences with `array_count_values()` just to take the keys or the
number of keys is an indirect way of deduplicating. Since PHP 7.2
`array_unique()` is fast and says what is meant: `array_values(array_unique($a))`
or `count(array_unique($a))`.

## Example

(PHP level 7.2)

::: code-group

```php{3,4} [Before]
<?php
function tally(array $votes, $batch) {
    $names = array_keys(array_count_values($votes['names']));
    $total = \count(\array_count_values(load($batch)));

    $flip  = array_flip(array_count_values($votes['names']));
    $pair  = count(array_count_values($votes['names'], $batch));
    $wrap  = count((array_count_values($votes['names'])));
    $obj   = $batch->count(array_count_values($votes['names']));
    return [$names, $total, $flip, $pair, $wrap, $obj];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function tally(array $votes, $batch) {
    $names = array_values(array_unique($votes['names']));
    $total = \count(\array_unique(load($batch)));

    $flip  = array_flip(array_count_values($votes['names']));
    $pair  = count(array_count_values($votes['names'], $batch));
    $wrap  = count((array_count_values($votes['names'])));
    $obj   = $batch->count(array_count_values($votes['names']));
    return [$names, $total, $flip, $pair, $wrap, $obj];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use &#39;array_values(array_unique($votes[&#39;names&#39;]))&#39; instead (array_unique() is fast since PHP 7.2).</li>
<li>line 4: Use &#39;count(array_unique(load($batch)))&#39; instead (array_unique() is fast since PHP 7.2).</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ArrayUniqueCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ArrayUniqueCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection ArrayUniqueCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
